title: Ember ingestion
description: Intake and enrichment by source and tenant, from Postgres through the CloudNativePG exporter (EMBER-111). Kept in infra/k8s/monitoring/grafana; edits made in Grafana are overwritten.

panels.title: Stored in range
panels.description: Deliveries intake verified and stored in the dashboard's time range, for the selected sources and tenants (raw_events). Each series counts from its lowest value in the range, so a series that first appears in the range misses its first sample. Retention deleting rows in the range can show too few. Red **No data** means the metric stopped arriving more than 5 minutes ago: its collector, its node or the whole cluster is down.

targets.expr: (sum(clamp_min(cnpg_raw_events_received_rows{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"} - min_over_time(cnpg_raw_events_received_rows{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$__range]), 0))) or on() (0 * max(cnpg_collector_up)) or on() vector(-1)

panels.title: Enriched in range
panels.description: Of all stored rows, how many more the enrich workers finished in the range. Red **No data** means the metric stopped arriving more than 5 minutes ago: its collector, its node or the whole cluster is down.

targets.expr: (sum(clamp_min(cnpg_raw_events_received_enriched{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"} - min_over_time(cnpg_raw_events_received_enriched{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$__range]), 0))) or on() (0 * max(cnpg_collector_up)) or on() vector(-1)

panels.title: Waiting for enrich
panels.description: Rows with a tenant that their source's enrich worker hasn't processed. Near 0 while the workers keep up. Red **No data** means the metric stopped arriving more than 5 minutes ago: its collector, its node or the whole cluster is down.

targets.expr: (sum(cnpg_raw_events_backlog_rows{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"})) or on() (0 * max(cnpg_collector_up)) or on() vector(-1)

panels.title: Oldest waiting
panels.description: How long the oldest row waiting for enrich has waited. Red **No data** means the metric stopped arriving more than 5 minutes ago: its collector, its node or the whole cluster is down.

targets.expr: (max(cnpg_raw_events_backlog_oldest_age_seconds{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"})) or on() (0 * max(cnpg_collector_up)) or on() vector(-1)

panels.title: Unmapped
panels.description: Rows from accounts no tenant is mapped to, which enrich never claims. Mapping and unmapped accounts, below, says which. Red **No data** means the metric stopped arriving more than 5 minutes ago: its collector, its node or the whole cluster is down.

targets.expr: (sum(cnpg_raw_events_unmapped_account_rows{source=~"$source"})) or on() (0 * max(cnpg_collector_up)) or on() vector(-1)

panels.title: Rate-limit gates closed
panels.description: Gates in rate_limits whose next_allowed_at is in the future: a worker is waiting out the source's API limit. Red **No data** means the metric stopped arriving more than 5 minutes ago: its collector, its node or the whole cluster is down.

targets.expr: (sum(cnpg_rate_limits_state_throttled{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"})) or on() (0 * max(cnpg_collector_up)) or on() vector(-1)

panels.title: Stored to enriched, slowest (15 min)
panels.description: The longest any row enriched in the last 15 minutes took from being stored to being enriched. A row that waited for its account to be mapped counts that wait too.

panels.title: Records
panels.description: Rows in source_records, one per object version, that enrich wrote. Red **No data** means the metric stopped arriving more than 5 minutes ago: its collector, its node or the whole cluster is down.

targets.expr: (sum(cnpg_source_records_totals_rows{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"})) or on() (0 * max(cnpg_collector_up)) or on() vector(-1)

panels.title: Records embedded
panels.description: Share of records the embed worker has embedded (EMBER-77). Low means embed is behind, stopped, or skipping a source.

panels.title: Workers
panels.description: Available replicas of intake, each enrich worker and embed. Red at 0. Red **No data** means the metric stopped arriving more than 5 minutes ago: its collector, its node or the whole cluster is down.

panels.title: Refused by intake (range)
panels.description: Deliveries intake answered with anything but stored or duplicate in the range: bad signatures, bad bodies, Postgres unavailable. The synthetic check and make apps-health post unsigned to /webhook/github on purpose, so a steady trickle of unauthorized is expected. Intake answers per minute, below, splits them by source and result.

panels.title: Sources and tenants
panels.description: One line per source and tenant, from Postgres. Stored and Enriched count every row retention kept (30 days after it is loaded). Records and Embedded are source_records. Last delivery and Last enriched are how long ago. (unmapped) rows belong to accounts no tenant is mapped to.

targets.expr: (sum by (source, tenant) (cnpg_raw_events_backlog_rows{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"})) or (0 * sum by (source, tenant) (cnpg_raw_events_received_rows{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"}))
sum by (source, tenant) (cnpg_source_records_totals_embedded{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"}) / sum by (source, tenant) (cnpg_source_records_totals_rows{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"})

panels.title: Stored per interval, by source and tenant
panels.description: Deliveries stored in raw_events per interval. Each bar is one interval of at least 5 min; the legend's Total covers the whole range.

targets.expr: sum by (source, tenant) (clamp_min(cnpg_raw_events_received_rows{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"} - cnpg_raw_events_received_rows{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"} offset $__interval, 0))

panels.title: Intake answers per minute, by source and result
panels.description: intake_deliveries_total from both intake pods. intake can't know the tenant when it answers, so this is by source only. unauthorized is a bad signature; unavailable means Postgres didn't take it in time.

panels.title: $source events by type
panels.description: Deliveries stored per interval by event type and tenant, from raw_events.event_name. One panel per selected source. Each bar is one interval of at least 5 min; the legend's Total covers the whole range.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant, event_name) (clamp_min(cnpg_raw_events_received_rows{source="$source", tenant=~"$tenant"} - cnpg_raw_events_received_rows{source="$source", tenant=~"$tenant"} offset $__interval, 0))

panels.title: Enriched per interval, by source and tenant
panels.description: Rows the enrich workers finished per interval. Bars that match Stored per interval mean enrich keeps up.

targets.expr: sum by (source, tenant) (clamp_min(cnpg_raw_events_received_enriched{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"} - cnpg_raw_events_received_enriched{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"} offset $__interval, 0))

panels.title: Waiting for enrich, by source and tenant
panels.description: Rows with a tenant not yet enriched. A line that keeps rising means a worker is stopped, failing or throttled.

panels.title: Stored to enriched (15 min windows)
panels.description: Seconds from stored to enriched for rows enriched in the last 15 minutes, average and slowest. A row that waited for its account to be mapped counts that wait too.

panels.title: Oldest waiting row
panels.description: How long the oldest row waiting for enrich has waited, by source and tenant.

panels.title: Rate limits
panels.description: The shared gates in rate_limits (GitHub: installation, Slack: method, Jira: site). Closed gates make a worker wait; Wait is until the last one opens. Remaining is the fewest calls left in any gate, where the API reports it.

panels.title: Records written per interval, by source and kind
panels.description: source_records rows enrich wrote per interval: one per object version (an edited message is a second row).

targets.expr: sum by (source, kind) (clamp_min(cnpg_source_records_totals_rows{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"} - cnpg_source_records_totals_rows{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"} offset $__interval, 0))

defaults.noValue: No records written in this range

panels.title: Records embedded, by source and tenant
panels.description: Share of source_records the embed worker has embedded. A flat line below 100% while records arrive means embed is behind or not reading that source.

targets.expr: sum by (source, tenant) (cnpg_source_records_totals_embedded{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"}) / sum by (source, tenant) (cnpg_source_records_totals_rows{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"})

panels.title: Records by kind
panels.description: source_records by source, tenant and kind. Last written and Last embedded are how long ago.

targets.expr: sum by (source, tenant, kind) (cnpg_source_records_totals_embedded{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"}) / sum by (source, tenant, kind) (cnpg_source_records_totals_rows{source=~"$source", tenant=~"$tenant"})

panels.title: Mapped accounts
panels.description: installations: each source account and the tenant its deliveries go to (make map-tenant).

panels.title: Unmapped accounts
panels.description: Accounts whose deliveries are stored with no tenant, waiting to be mapped with make map-tenant SOURCE=<source> ACCOUNT=<account_id> TENANT=<tenant>. (none) is a delivery that names no account, such as GitHub's app-wide ping and security_advisory events: no mapping claims those.

panels.title: Problems from intake and the workers
panels.description: Lines from intake, the enrich workers and embed that mention an error, a warning, a failure or a traceback.

panels.title: Enrich activity
panels.description: Every line the enrich workers log: one per row enriched, plus start, listening and stop.
